description:
List every webhook endpoint you registered, newest first, with its events and whether deliveries work. At most 5 exist, so it is one page. The signing secret is never listed.
Use for: seeing where your events go, and finding an endpoint that was switched off after failures.
Not for: adding an endpoint (create_webhook_endpoint); seeing what was sent to an endpoint (list_webhook_deliveries).
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: list_webhook_endpoints({})
Errors: only the common ones; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.
name: list_webhook_endpoints

consecutiveFailures.description: Failed deliveries in a row since the last success, test events included.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

description.description: Your own note. Left out when none was given.

disabledAt.description: When it was switched off. Left out while it is on.

disabledReason.description: Why it was switched off. Left out while it is on.

events.description: Event names this endpoint receives, for example application.submitted or message.received. ["*"] means every event.

isEnabled.description: True while this endpoint receives events. Left out (false) when disabled after repeated failed deliveries. Delete it and create it again to receive events.

lastFailureAt.description: Last failed delivery. Left out when none failed.

lastSuccessAt.description: Last delivery your URL accepted. Left out before the first.

title: List your webhook endpoints
